notes: לַעֲבֹדָה carries no separately segmented article token, so its *the* is placed on the noun under rule 15; the segmented [הַ] of בַּכֹּחַ is unrepresented because the ASV writes *in strength* bare.
אִישׁ־חַיִל is rendered attributively as *able men* under rule 28.
מִן heads the prepositional predicate and takes the construction-supplied copula under rule 49.
